data.description: 【莱万汀 · 火锅挑战】基地食堂热气滚滚的九宫格变态辣火锅桌前，莱万汀两眼放光地盯着锅里翻滚的红油与辣椒，熟练地捞起一大块爽脆毛肚塞入口中，辣得直哈气却大呼痛快——「这才叫真正的吃饭！管理员，连这种程度的辣都受不了可成不了优秀的指挥官哦，快张嘴吃这块牛肉！」
data.promptProse: At the base canteen table, Laevatain lifts a piece of tripe from the divided spicy hotpot with chopsticks, cheeks warm as she blows out a breath after tasting it. Her cropped gray techwear jacket and black utility skirt retain their cafe outfit. The medium view places bubbling red oil before her and seating farther back. Bright cafeteria light illuminates rising steam and catches the oil beside the chili peppers.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 火锅挑战
